_comment: Projects you can open by voice: 'open <name> [for ticket 1234] [request]'. Copy to projects.json and edit. dir is the main checkout; each session gets its own worktree <dir>--<name> on a new branch from base_branch. copy lists git-ignored files to bring into the worktree. ticket_prefix names the branch (SHOP-1234-alpha); ticket_spoken lists how you say the prefix aloud when it is not a word; ticket_request is what the session is asked to do with the ticket. web is the project's page on GitLab or GitHub, ticket_url the address of a ticket with {key} in it: the board turns !23 and ticket keys into links with them. bin/roger (agents per ticket in Herdr) also reads ticket_info, a command that prints a ticket as JSON (summary, subtask, parent), and agent_args, flags for the claude it starts.

projects.name: shop-ui
projects.ticket_request: Read the ticket and send me the plan in three sentences.
